How to visit a museum
and actually enjoy it
Don't try to see everything. Pick one or two rooms. Two hours of attention beats five hours of tired walking.
Spend five minutes in front of one piece. Look at the details, the colours, the faces. You'll see things most visitors miss.
Read the story behind a work. Who made it, why, and what was happening at the time. The story makes the art come alive.
Go at quiet times. Early mornings or weekday evenings. Fewer crowds make the experience calmer and more personal.
Learn a little before you go. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I recognise artists and periods in every museum now.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I recognise artists and periods in every museum now.

slides.texte_overlay: Go with a friend and talk about what you see. Sharing opinions about a painting makes the visit fun and memorable.
Finish at the café. Sit, talk, look back on what you liked. A good visit ends with a moment to remember it. Plan the next one.
